_meta.name: ecological_fallacy
_meta.description: Ecological regression pattern: per-region means of income and age (the aggregation half) plus an individual-level REG_OLS income~age for comparison. A true ecological fit would regress mean_income ~ mean_age over a per-region cohort; per skills/regression-modeling.md, ship that as a second pulse_compose slot over a pre-aggregated .pulse file. Carries the ecological-fallacy caveat: a per-region slope does not imply an individual-level association.
